segments.text: Every is an adjective that is used to describe a repeated activity or event.
segments.fa: Every یک صفتیه که برای توصیف فعالیت یا رویداد تکراری استفاده می‌شه.

segments.text: It shows how often this activity or event happens or is done.
segments.fa: این نشون می‌ده که این فعالیت یا رویداد چقدر تکرار می‌شه یا انجام می‌شه.

segments.fa: مثلاً جمله «من هر روز ساعت ۶ صبح بیدار می‌شوم» را در نظر بگیر.

segments.text: I wake up at 6 a.m. every day.
The repeated action is waking up.

segments.text: The adjective every describes the noun day.
segments.fa: صفت every اسم day رو توصیف می‌کنه.

segments.text: Notice that the verb wake up is in the simple present,
segments.fa: دقت کن که فعل wake up به شکل ساده حال (simple present) هست، که می‌تونه برای توصیف کارهای منظم و تکراری استفاده بشه.

segments.text: a verb form that can be used to describe regular, repeated actions.
Although the verb is called the simple present, it does not exactly connect with the present time.
segments.fa: اگرچه این فعل «simple present» نامیده می‌شه، دقیقاً به زمان حال وصل نیست.

segments.text: It suggests that something often happens or is generally true.

segments.text: Notice that the adjective every describes the noun time.
In this case, time does not mean hours, minutes, or seconds.

segments.text: Instead, time means an instance of something happening.
